plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'English AA-T Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 23, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7981/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 61-62; lower bound 61 encoded = 15+16+15+15 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 1 Area 2 3-4 -> 3). The two Cal-GETC Area 4 slots must total 6 units from 2 disciplines per the map (map prints IGETC). ENGL 301 pre-req per map: 'ENGL C1000 and C1000H' (C1000H is the honors version of C1000); encoded as the in-plan ENGL C1000. ENGL C1001 pre-req per map: ENGL C1000 / ENGL C1000H / ENGL C1000E / C-ID ENGL 100; encoded as the in-plan ENGL C1000. List A (minimum 6 units; one 3-unit slot in Semester 3, one in Semester 4): ENGLT 310, ENGLT 311, ENGLT 320, ENGLT 321, ENGLT 340, ENGLT 341 — all require ENGL C1000 (or eligibility for ENGL C1000 for ENGLT 320); ENGL C1000 is sequenced in Semester 1. List B (minimum 3 units, or any List A course not taken; one slot in Semester 4): ENGCW 400 (eligible for ENGL C1000), ENGLT 335, or any List A course not taken. List C (minimum 3 units, or any List A or B course not taken; one slot in Semester 4): ENGCW 400, ENGCW 410, ENGCW 420, ENGCW 430, ENGCW 452 (4 units), ENGED 305 (ENGL C1000), ENGLT 303, ENGLT 330, ENGLT 335, ENGLT 336, ENGLT 343, ENGLT 345, ENGLT 360, ENGLT 365, ENGLT 370, ENGLT 402, JOUR 300, SPAN 426 (SPAN 412 or 415), SPAN 427 (SPAN 412 or 415), TA 300 — most require eligibility for ENGL C1000. List-slot prerequisites are documented here rather than encoded, because option-specific requirements (e.g. SPAN 412/415 for SPAN 426/427) do not map to single plan courses. Elective units are determined by the number needed to total 60 units for graduation; refer to Course Number for the appropriate course level. Semester 1: map recommends meeting with a counselor (ENGL C1000 and Area 2).
